compiled_state.description:
Operator ruling (2026-08-22): the rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm fired 5 times in 2 days; investigation proved every incident was a transient, self-healing event handled by designed recovery paths (review timeout -> backfill retry; curl-28 clone stalls under merge-burst load; retryable-gap budgets escalating to the designed fail-closed -1). All affected changes merged with LLM-Review +1; none required operator attention. Ruling: recalibrate the alarm to reduce noise — transient self-healing errors should not page; a SUSTAINED voter failure (the fail-closed gate actually stuck, e.g. expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit down) must still alarm loudly.

Current shape (aws describe-alarms, 2026-08-22): metric rebar/host:voter_errors, Sum over period 300s, threshold 0, GreaterThanThreshold, 1 evaluation period, TreatMissingData=notBreaching. I.e. a single marker in any 5-minute window alarms. Terraform source: infra/terraform/monitoring_s4b.tf.

Evidence base for calibration (2-day sample, from journald + CloudWatch):
- Transient incidents: 1 isolated marker (double-counted to 2 pre-dedup-fix; companion bug fixes that), clearing within one interval. 5 such incidents in 48h under 4-session heavy load.
- A sustained failure mode emits markers on EVERY review attempt: the webhook queue + backfill reconciler retry continuously, so an expired token / LLM outage produces a continuous marker stream across consecutive intervals, not an isolated spike.
- Precedents: mirror-guard fix 969acad79b4b (sustained-divergence window, single-sample alarm was incomplete-implementation); operator ruling on 3ff9 (suppress expected-contention noise); CloudWatch replication alarm uses 2x5-min sustained (monitoring_ws7.tf).

Design constraints:
- The discriminator is PERSISTENCE, not magnitude: alarm on markers present across consecutive evaluation periods (e.g. N-of-M datapoints > 0, sized so an isolated self-healing error never fires but a stuck gate fires within ~15 minutes), rather than raising the count threshold (a burst of distinct transient errors is still transient; one error repeating forever is the outage).
- Keep OK/ALARM actions and the fail-closed rationale in the alarm description; update the description to name the calibration rationale and this ticket.
- Coordinate with the double-count bug fix (companion ticket, blocks this one): calibrate against deduplicated counts.
- Terraform-only change (monitoring_s4b.tf + any doc). Landing the .tf through Gerrit does NOT apply it: flag in the close comment whether apply happens via the existing drift/apply workflow or needs the operator; do not run terraform apply against AWS yourself without checking how this repo's terraform changes are applied (read infra/ runbooks + terraform-drift.yml first). If apply requires a human, land the change, comment what remains, and close only if the ticket ACs are met by the landed change per repo convention for infra changes (check how prior monitoring_*.tf changes were handled — e.g. the adb6/58a3/mirror-guard lanes).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Alarm no longer fires on an isolated self-healing marker; fires within ~15 min of a sustained marker stream.
- [ ] Both behaviors covered by whatever test tier monitoring .tf changes get in this repo (see prior monitoring_*.tf changes for the pattern; terraform validate at minimum).
- [ ] Description text updated with rationale + ticket reference.
- [ ] Application path (auto vs operator apply) explicitly recorded on the ticket.
compiled_state.title: Recalibrate voter-errors alarm to sustained-failure detection
